◆ get_os_name()

std::string os_utils::get_os_name ( )
static

Get the operating system name and version.

Most of Linux distribution have the file "/etc/os-release" which contain the name of the operating system and the version. This function extract it from the file and return it.

Returns
std::string containing operating system name and version.

◆ system_call_with_output()

std::string os_utils::system_call_with_output ( const std::string &  cmd,
bool  enable_stderr = false 
)
static

Operates system call and return its output.

If enable_stderr is enabled, requested call stdout and stderr are returned. Output of command is limited to size of buffer defined in the method (10kb).

Parameters
[in]cmdcommand string.
[in]enable_stderrrequest get output from stderr with stdout.
Returns
Returns system call output string.
